column1: # THE TWO AXES THAT MUST NOT BE COLLAPSED
#  1. FUNCTION-LEVEL OWNER: which component owns the function.
#  2. DECISION-LEVEL OWNER: which component owns the BEHAVIOUR SELECTED
#     at the branch. A function can be function-level C and
#     decision-level C, or function-level C and decision-level
#     POLYC, and a third option: the C branch reads a PolyC-produced
#     value but ADDS its own policy, which is C_SEMANTIC_RETAINED_WP001,
#     NOT POLYC_OWNED_DECISION_PROVEN.
# THE ROUTE SCOPE AXIS
#  WP001_REQUIRED_ROUTE  the frozen route: --install-dir=X -c input.HC -o out.o
#  WHOLE_CLI_SURFACE   every route the CLI can take
#  A live but OFF-ROUTE C semantic choice is reported in the GLOBAL
#  count and NOT folded into the route-scoped count. The global count
#  is never asserted to be zero without its own evidence.
